verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an online IP filing portal, since such portals could offer batch filing, renewal or fee payment. Nothing in the pack documents acting on many applications or registrations at once. The nearest items are partial renewal of a single registration, dividing one application into several, and updating representative data. These are single-item actions, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
